subject: history
context: Phase 3 retry for history: re-attempt download of every non-external source regardless of the access_status left by the earlier Phase 3 run(s), because a retry must re-test previously inaccessible sources.
rationale: The earlier Phase 3 runs failed for every source (sandbox TLS restriction to Google services). Skipping them would make the retry vacuous; simulating success would violate AGENTS.md rules 4-5. Re-attempting every non-external source is the only honest retry.

subject: history
